hints.text: 'Changed', 'to protect', and 'initially' are our indicators — one tells us to anagram some letters, another tells us to put some letters around some others, and a third tells us which part of a word to select.
Our fodder is 'surname' and 'privacy'. We'll use these letters (or some of them) to construct our answer, as directed by the indicator(s).

The definition is 'Undercover reporter' - and the question mark on the end suggests that this definition is a slight stretch. It may also push you on your pop culture knowledge a little. If you're finding it obscure, turning to the wordplay section might be your best bet!
